supported_lifecycle.meaning: A successful 204 returns immediately without reading a response body.
Logout issues DELETE /session through the typed API client and settles the session transition on success.
The successful logout callback navigates to /login.
Server session revocation is awaited before the route returns 204 and a clearing cookie.

diagnosis: Both browser DELETE requests had a successful 204 response and a net::ERR_ABORTED transport event during their UI logout phase. Both UI logout checks succeeded, both retained original cookies were rejected with 401 after explicit DELETE204 cleanup, and profiles were removed. A post-header transport cancellation cannot undo the completed server revocation. The harness incorrectly treated these events as failed logout operations.
cause_limit: The exact Chromium/tunnel cancellation mechanism and event timing relative to SPA navigation are not established by the original evidence. The recorded phase is UI logout, before helper context cleanup; context closure is not asserted as the cause.
narrow_correction: Assign content-free per-request IDs. Classify only net::ERR_ABORTED DELETE to the exact API /api/session URL during that actor UI logout, after the same browser request has response204, and only when login200/captured original cookie/UI logout204/navigation to /login/explicit DELETE204/original cookie GET401 are all proven. Preserve the event; exclude only this corroborated case from unexpected failures.

reload_failure.supported_cause: The imports response waiter matched an older request (46), issued during explicit refresh before reload document request47. The waiter resolved on the old response while page.reload disposed its document. Its subsequent response.json operation then failed before a history_reload check was recorded. The original helper discarded the underlying error name/message and overwrote the failure phase during finally; the specific Playwright error is therefore inferred, not recorded.
reload_failure.correction: Pin reads to content-free request IDs and navigation generations captured when requests start. Require explicit refresh request to start after its own action boundary; require reload response request to start in the new document generation after main-frame navigation. Preserve safe error class, message SHA and operation phase before finally. Separate all-created-session cleanup from completion of both planned actors.
reload_failure.created_session_cleanup: Alice was the sole created session: DELETE204, exact original cookie GET401, private profile removed. Carol was never started.
